headline: Armed Groups Seize Congo’s Vital Cobalt Deposit, Threatening Global Tech Supply Chains
summary: Armed groups seizing a crucial cobalt deposit in Congo creates immediate and significant disruption to the global supply of a critical mineral vital for EV batteries, AI infrastructure, and high-performance electronics. This kinetic event exacerbates geopolitical instability in a key resource-rich region, directly impacting rare earth markets and forcing supply chain re-evaluation.
